tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// lha mo shrā ma ṇa'i sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa shel dkar me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// thugs rje byin rlabs spo mtho'i ri bo nas// lung bstan dpyid kyi pho nya'i glu dbyangs kyis// dge mtshan gsar pa'i dus ston 'dren mdzad pa// lhag pa'i lha mo shrā ma ṇa la 'dud// sngon byas dge dang mi dge'i ri mo bzhin// legs nyes rnam par bkra ba bzhin gyi mdangs// ji bzhin snang bar byed pa'i ā darsha// rmi lam sgrub pa'i gdams pa 'dir bshad bya// de'ang 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub gyi rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa las/ oṃ shrā ma ṇa pi shā tsi ni muṇḍe swā hā/ ba ru ra'i shing ngam n+ya gro dha'i shing gi rtsa bar 'dug la/ cang mi smra bar 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na grub par 'gyur te 'jig rten gsum gyi spyod pa yang ston par 'gyur ro// yang na legs par khrus byas pa la gos gtsang ma bgos te dben par 'dug la khri bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro// dgong ka nyal khar ru rta la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas nas gdong dang rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas/ rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba rnams ston par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i lha mchog khyad par can 'di nyid la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la/ dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi bsnyen cing bsgrubs te las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ shin tu dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su phyag dar byas la spos chus chag chag gdab/ sbyor ba rtsom pa'i sngon gyi nyin gnyis gsum tsam la dkar gtor gtsang zhing gya nom pa dkar gsum sogs zas sna du ma dang bcas gzhi bdag rnams la dgung re bzhin bsngos te las bcol/ de nas bgegs gtor btang*/ gu gul gyis bdug mtshams tho bslangs te 'phags skyes por gsal btab nas/ mtshams nang du bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phrin las bcol/ mchod pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham/

khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas/ 'og tu sa dkar gyis g.yung drung bris pa'i 'bol stan sogs la tshul dang mthun par 'khod de/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ khyad par bdag gis ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che bde blag tu 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o// snyam du bsam/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig mthing ga de las 'od zer phyogs bcur spros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me dpung 'bar bas yongs su bskor bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re rakṣa rakṣa swā hā zhes pa ci mang bzla/ 'di'i sgrub pa'i bogs 'don gyi mchog tu gyur pa ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byed pa yin pas/ rdor sems sgom bzlas la 'bad dgos shing*/ de ni cho ga gzhan las 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyas pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams la yig brgya bzla/ mjug tu/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de'ang yig brgya 'bum phrag bzla bar gsungs pa bzhin byung na legs shing*/ ma mtha' yang nyin bdun la thun bzhir bcad de yig brgya gtso bor 'don pa dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥzhes pa bsnan te 'bum gyi grangs gsog go /de'i zhar la phyag sbyang dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs nan tan shin tu che bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang gi sngas mgor stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du rdul tshon nam ras gzhi la padma 'dab brgyad bris/ de'i dbus su bum pa gtsang ma bya rgyud kyi bum rdzas dang dkar gsum sogs bsgos pa'i chu gtsang gis bkang ba/ shug pa lta bu'i kha rgyan la tsaka li btags pa'i steng nas dar sngon po'i gur phub/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ phyogs gcig tu sgrol dkar gyi bris 'bur ci rigs mchod pa dang bcas pa/ thun mthar 'bul rgyu'i dkar gtor gsum bcas bshams/ a mṛ ta'i sngags bzlas te chab kyis bran/ dri bzang gi chus kha dag par byas/ dri bzang pos bsgos pa'i me tog lag tu bzung zhing*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas bsdus pa bya rgyud ltar gyi mchod pa byin rlabs bcas sngon du btang*/ bdag bskyed ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid tām̐ yig dkar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar mtheb srin gyis 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/

rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya tā re arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma sogs kyis bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gzungs spobs mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā zhes pa ci nus bzlas la yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs/ mdun bskyed ni/ swa bhā wa nas ko3haṃ/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ rtse mor dpag bsam gyi ljon pa chen po lo ma dang me tog rab tu rgyas pas mtshan pa/ ri rab kyi steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo shrā ma ṇa sku mdog sngon mo/ sked pa phra ba/ nu ma rgyas pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad can ri rab la stegs 'dug gi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas me long dang rnga yab/ g.yon dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ shin tu dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ blang dor mtha' dag gsal bar lung ston pa'i tshul gyis rang la gzigs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ de bī shrā ma ṇa arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal kun ting 'dzin bye ba'i 'jug ldang gi// sgyu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i ga bur zer// skal bzang kun dā'i gnyen du shar ba'i lha// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rig mun par 'thoms pa'i 'gro ba la// brtse chen thugs rje'i 'od kyi sgrol ma yis// 'phral yun legs nyes blang dor ma lus pa// gsal bar ston cig 'phags ma thugs rje'i gter// bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed kyis bdag la don 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba'i blang dor mtha' dag bslu ba med pa gsal bar lung bstan du gsol/

zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab la lag pas me tog sna lnga ba'i phreng bar bsam zhing lha mo'i dbu la bcings par mos te bum pa'i nang du gzhug lha mo'i thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khod par dmigs te yid gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas/ oṃ shrā ma ṇa pi shā tsi ni muṇḍe swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun mthar yig brgyas lhag chad bskang zhing*/ thun tha ma la gtor ma bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te cha gcig mtshan sngags la ba liṃ ta btags pas bla ma dang shrā ma ṇa la 'bul/ cha gcig a kā ros chos skyong la/ cha gcig sambha ras gzhi bdag la bsngo/ thun gyi tshe tha mal pa'i gtam/ gnyid dang 'og rlung*/ lha gzhan gyi sngags bzlas pa sogs kyang ma shor ba bya la/ gal te byung na thun btang ste khrus byas nas slar sdom zhing snga ma sngags kyi grangs su mi gzhug go /thun mtshams su sgrol ma dang*/ yig brgyar 'bad pa dang lha mo'i sngags rgyun par bzla zhing*/ lhag par nyal khar gang mang 'don la/ nyal ba'i tshe lha mo'i pang du mgo bzhag par mos nas sngas byang du bstan/ g.yas 'og tu bcug nas sngags bgrang bzhin par gnyid du 'gro ba bya/ mtshams kyi skabs mi khyi sogs dang mi 'phrad cing*/ sha chang sgog btsong la phug sogs sngo rjed kyi rigs/ dkor zas dang grib can gyi zas sogs la 'dzem/ 'tsho ba dkar gsum la bsten cing phyi dro'i kha zas spang*/ zas phud bla ma dang lha mo la 'bul/ zas kyi mjug dang*/ zag pa dor rjes khrus bya ba sogs gtsang sbra la 'bad/ de ltar 'bad pas dag bdun nas ma grub na/ sgrib pa dang grib shas che ba yin pas bshags bsdam dang rnam 'joms kyi gzungs chus khrus sogs nan tan byas te slar bsgrub cing bdun phrag gsum gyis mi 'grub mi srid par gsungs/ grub pa'i mtshan ma byung ba na thog mar bstan pa'i bya ba'am skye ba phyi ma'i don lta bu 'gang che ba re re tsam la brtag mi gsal na bskyar nas brtags te rim gyis don gnyis gsum sogs mang du gtong zhing*/

brda don myong steng nas dpyad shes pa gal che la/ lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste yun du bsten na slar mngon sum du lung ston par 'gyur ro// kun rdzob rdzun pa rgyu 'bras bya byed kun// nyid 'khrul rdzun pa rmi lam gyis bstan bzhin// legs nyes bden pa blang dor la 'bad pas// chos nyid bden pa mngon sum rtogs gyur cig /ces lha mo shrā ma ṇa'i sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa shel dkar me long zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa 'jam dbyangs bzod pas bskul ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// 'di nyid khri gung thang rin po che'i dngos slob dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas mdun nas rje bla mas gsan cing rgyud kyi lung gsar 'dzud dang 'di'i sgo nas lag len rtags thon yod pa'i zhal rgyun phyag bris ma ltar bshus shing lung spel zhus pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
